requirement.requiredInputs: Ship particulars, protection arrangement, and linked MARPOL compliance evidence
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: For category A and B oil tankers of less than 5,000 tonnes deadweight constructed on or after 1 January 2017, the entire cargo tank length shall be protected with: double bottom tanks or spaces complying with the applicable requirements of regulation 19.6.1 of MARPOL Annex I; and wing tanks or spaces arranged in accordance with regulation 19.3.1 of MARPOL Annex I and complying with the applicable requirements for distance referred to in regulation 19.6.2 of MARPOL Annex I.
